Reference

Every command, in one place.

Almost every command uses your server prefix. Nothing here needs a dashboard to configure. Slash commands (`/`) exist only for interactions and roleplay, `/setup` and reports.

Almost every command works with the server’s configurable prefix (default !), and many also as slash commands (/). Use the switch to see each way.

/reactionunmute <user> [reason]

/protect honeypot add <channel> [punishment]

Enable a honeypot channel and post its warning panel.

!protect honeypot remove <channel>
/protect honeypot remove <channel>

/protect verify template <which> [template]

/protect verify channel <channel>

Post the verification panel in a channel, so members can verify there too.

/protect verify checks [check] [mode] [min_age] [avatar] [flagged] [common]

/protect verify status

Show the current verification setup.

/protect verify send <user>

/protect roletrigger remove <role>

/protect roletrigger limit [amount] [reset]

!mod ban <user> [delete_message_days] [duration] [reason]

Look up a case by its number.

Everything moderation knows about a member: cases, notes, reports and current status.

Jail a member until they are released, or for a set time.

!mod unjail <user> [reason]

Release a member from jail and give their roles back.

!mod nickname <user> <nickname>

Change the nickname of a member.

!mod stripstaff <user> [reason]

!lockdown config [pause_invites] [raise_verification] [auto_end_minutes] [announce_channel] [message]
/lockdown config [pause_invites] [raise_verification] [auto_end_minutes] [announce_channel] [message]

Choose what a lockdown does.

!lockdown channel add <channel>
/lockdown channel add <channel>

Close this channel in a lockdown.

!lockdown channel remove <channel>
/lockdown channel remove <channel>

Stop closing this channel.

!appeals [setting] [value]
/appeals [setting] [value]

See the appeal page of this server and the appeals waiting for an answer.

!antinuke status
/antinuke status

See every protection: on or off, its limit and what it does.

!antinuke rule <protection> [enabled] [limit] [window_seconds] [action] [alert_channel]
/antinuke rule <protection> [enabled] [limit] [window_seconds] [action] [alert_channel]

Turn a protection on or off and tune it.

!antinuke whitelist add [user] [role]
/antinuke whitelist add [user] [role]

Trust an account or a role.

!antinuke whitelist remove [user] [role]
/antinuke whitelist remove [user] [role]

Stop trusting an account or a role.

!antinuke whitelist list
/antinuke whitelist list

See who is trusted.

!antinuke panic [enabled] [incidents] [window_minutes] [lockdown_minutes] [on_raid]
/antinuke panic [enabled] [incidents] [window_minutes] [lockdown_minutes] [on_raid]

Lock the server down by itself when several protections act or a raid starts.

!antinuke settings [dm_owner] [owner_only]
/antinuke settings [dm_owner] [owner_only]

Who can change the anti-nuke and who hears about an attack.

!antinuke admins add <user>
/antinuke admins add <user>

Make an account a trusted admin.

!antinuke admins remove <user>
/antinuke admins remove <user>

Remove a trusted admin.

!antinuke admins list
/antinuke admins list

See the trusted admins.

!antinuke log
/antinuke log

The last times a protection acted.

!antinuke restore <event>
/antinuke restore <event>

Put back what a protection stopped (channels, roles, bans, roles taken away).

!antiscam status
/antiscam status

See how the anti scam is set.

!antiscam set [enabled] [action] [mute_minutes] [delete_messages] [delete_minutes] [channels] ...
/antiscam set [enabled] [action] [mute_minutes] [delete_messages] [delete_minutes] [channels]

Turn it on or off and tune it.

!antiscam exempt add [role] [channel]
/antiscam exempt add [role] [channel]

Never check a role or a channel.

!antiscam exempt remove [role] [channel]
/antiscam exempt remove [role] [channel]

Check a role or a channel again.

!antiscam exempt list
/antiscam exempt list

See what is never checked.

!antiscam log
/antiscam log

The last scams it caught.

!clearinvites
/clearinvites

Delete every invite of the server, after a confirmation.

Image mute a member.

!imute remove <user> [reason]

Give a member their files and embeds back.

!rmute user <user> [reason]

Reaction mute a member.

!rmute remove <user> [reason]

Give a member their reactions and external emojis back.

Change the nickname of a member.

!nickname reset <user>
/nickname reset <user>

Remove the nickname of a member.

!nickname force <user> [nickname]
/nickname force <user> [nickname]

Keep a nickname on a member: Petto puts it back whenever it changes.

!nickname unforce <user>
/nickname unforce <user>

Stop forcing the nickname of a member.

!nickname forced
/nickname forced

List the forced nicknames of this server.

!raid clean <duration> [action] [reason]
/raid clean <duration> [action] [reason]

Ban or kick the members who joined in this time (asks first).

!raid list [duration]
/raid list [duration]

See who joined in this time.

!stripstaff <user> [reason]
/stripstaff <user> [reason]

Remove every role with staff permissions from a member.

!thread rename <name> [thread]
/thread rename <name> [thread]

/thread lock [thread] [reason]

/thread unlock [thread] [reason]
